author: /root/project_architecture

completion_manifest.bounds: Exact six graph summaries,exact23 successful partition rows; finite failed_attempt list such that complete manifest<=2097152bytes/50000nodes/depth48 and future package caps. If complete evidence cannot fit, typed refusal and separate reviewed design; no omissions.
completion_manifest.record_references: Every transport/scope/claim/parent_witness/saved_result_review/Root_adoption/failure is a whole fact3; all existed before this manifest. Graph/partition data exactly fixed plan, graph order fixed6 and partition order original23. failed_attempts retains every known consumed unsuccessful attempt in recorded order; cannot count it as a successful partition.
completion_manifest.status: CAPTURE_COMPLETE_EXACT_BYTES_METADATA_ONLY only after all23 accepted whole transports; otherwise no completion manifest issued
completion_manifest.truth: metadata_onlyTrue; all authority/runtime/compatibility/ready flagsFalse. Creation does not by itself accept manifest; separate genuinely different saved whole-byte/in-memory-reconstruction review and Root adoption are outside manifest, avoiding self-reference.

failure.authority_flags: allFalse; missing output remains absent, never filled
failure.export_behavior: Raise exact new typed error; never return successful partial transport. MemoryError/BaseException/seal corruption abort.
failure.message: bounded builtin str<=512; no body/Base64/Source/traceback dump

input.capture_id: canonical lowercase UUID from future exact Scope/claim; no authority
input.catalogue_bytes: builtin bytes exact original catalogue008 hash/length
input.module_carriers: exact ModuleType; only source/API raw builtin bytes and closed fact3 via __dict__; original closed9 fixed pins; no function/callback accepted
input.partition_id: exact builtin str selected fixed identifier; no arbitrary predicate/path/ordinal list
input.selection_bytes: builtin strict JSON bytes exact original fixed Root plan raw hash/length,<=2MiB; preserve its original whitespace, never require or substitute a canonical reserialization

output.canonical_wire: UTF8 json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False)+'\n'; exact wire roundtrip; no BOM/duplicate/unknown keys/floats/nonfinite/surrogates/bool counters/subclasses

fields.capture_id: builtin str canonical lowercase UUID, exact future scope/claim label; never authority
fields.record_set_LF_fact3_sha256: exact complete original ordered roster digest
fields.records: ordered nonempty rows matching selected ordinals exactly
fields.selected_ordinals: exact nonempty plan ordinal list in original order
fields.snapshot: exact original accepted saved snapshot fact3

output.header_budget: Replace records by [] in complete output; canonical bytes<=65536 and full key/value nodes<=4096. Complete output<=2097152/depth48/nodes50000; every4-field row adds15nodes.

row.body_base64: builtin ASCII str; RFC4648 standard alphabet/padding; no whitespace; strict decode then reencode byte equality
row.ordinal: builtin int,nonbool, exact selected original1-based ordinal
row.pin: closed {path:str,bytes:int,sha256:str}; all3 exactly original graph pin

primitive_rules.all_input_data: detached builtin-only snapshot; no arbitrary callbacks, predicates, module getters or mutable authority objects
primitive_rules.capture_id: builtin str36characters, lowercase8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal UUID spelling; parsed/reformatted value identical; identity only
primitive_rules.enums_and_bools: type is exactly builtin; no subclasses/equality callbacks; every consumed key exact builtin str

fact3.path: builtin str exactly fixed original spelling,1..512characters; no normalization/alias/case substitution
fact3.sha256: builtin str exactly64 lowercase ASCII hexadecimal

primitive_rules.input_JSON: strictUTF8, no BOM,duplicatekeys,floats/nonfinite,surrogates; complete byte cap and wholepin before data use
primitive_rules.labels: ordered list builtin str aliases copied exactly from original graph; not authority
primitive_rules.nullable_fields: None only where expressly allowed; none of success transport fields nullable

selection_plan_shape: Exact whole fixed Root plan plus its closed graph/roster/partition schemas and all digest/budget invariants in contract; no replacement by caller views.
